• Etiology / Neurobiology: Inhibition of aldehyde dehydrogenase permits acetaldehyde accumulation with ethanol.
• Clinical Presentation & DSM Criteria: A 35-year-old abstinent drinker seeks an aversive medicine and understands the consequences of drinking alcohol; temporal criterion or course: after detoxification and informed consent.
• Diagnostics / Key Findings: The plan relies on a predictable unpleasant alcohol reaction.
• Management / Adverse Effects: Use selectively with close counseling and adherence support; important distinction or complication: flushing, vomiting, hypotension, and more severe alcohol reactions can occur. (First Aid 36th ed., 2026, printed p. 594)
